title: Th1 as the helper-cell programme
dek: Wikipedia's T helper 1 page is the CD4 programme that talks in IFN-γ. HIV's CD4 loss is the common phenocopy.
story: Th1 on Wikipedia is a CD4 T-cell polarisation: T-bet, IFN-γ, help for macrophages. TB textbooks treat it as the canonical helpful programme against Mtb.
HIV depletes CD4 cells and scrambles this help — the common acquired phenocopy of Mendelian IFN-γ defects. That is already a Simplfy HIV plate; this card is the helper-subset name.
Th2/Th17/Treg exist on neighbouring encyclopedia pages. Do not turn a TB course into a complete T-cell atlas here; just keep Th1 as a graph node that points at IFN-γ, IL-12, and granulomas.
deepTitle: Programme, not a stain that diagnoses TB
deep: Counting Th1 cells in blood is not a WRD.
BCG and subunit vaccines aim, in different ways, at this programme. Efficacy still comes from trials, not from the Th1 infobox.
Exhaustion and tissue-resident memory are research-layer words; they do not change DST.
Anti-TNF and corticosteroids hurt the neighbourhood of this programme by different doors.
